# Animated rabbit

- Source: [Rabbit by CDmir and TinyWorlds](https://opengameart.org/content/rabbit-0)
- License: CC0 1.0 (the original `LICENSE.txt` is retained beside the model)
- Source format: rigged FBX with embedded animation and separate diffuse /
  normal textures

ICEWAY loads this model only through `WinterAnimalModelLibrary`; wildlife
simulation and saves refer to the stable `RABBIT` species id, never this file
name. It can therefore be replaced without migrating ecosystem data.
